name: Dolomites
about: Winter (Dec–Mar) is prime skiing across the Dolomiti Superski network; summer (Jun–Sep) is prime hiking and via ferrata season; the shoulder mud seasons (Apr–May, Oct–Nov) see many lifts and hotels close.
overview: Jagged limestone spires glowing pink at sunset, South Tyrolean villages, and the world's largest interconnected ski network — northern Italy's Alps.
costOverview: Mountain-hut meals and coffee are reasonable — lift tickets and the Dolomiti Superski network pass are the real expense.

hiking.label: Summer trail and via ferrata access
